paragraphs.source_en: O-Mitsu trotted all the way back to Princess Sen's quarters. A year ago, she would have gathered the boy Hideyori into her arms without a second thought and kissed his little face; but now—such was the sorrow of this mortal world.

units.source_en: O-Mitsu trotted all the way back to Princess Sen's quarters.
units.source_zh: 阿蜜一路小跑回到千姬的住处。

units.source_en: A year ago, she would have gathered the boy Hideyori into her arms without a second thought and kissed his little face; but now—such was the sorrow of this mortal world.

ja.t: しさというものだった。

units.source_zh: 要是一年前，她会不假思索抱住秀赖这孩子，亲吻他的小脸，然而现在——这真是一种人世的悲凉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿蜜一路小跑回到千姬的住处。要是一年前，她会不假思索抱住秀赖这孩子，亲吻他的小脸，然而现在——这真是一种人世的悲凉。

paragraphs.source_en: “Lady Sakae, what is the matter? Your eyes are so red.” asked the elderly attendant who had accompanied her from Edo. Only then did O-Mitsu realize that her tears had ruined the makeup on her face.

units.source_en: asked the elderly attendant who had accompanied her from Edo.
units.source_zh: 从江户跟来的嬷嬷问她。

units.source_en: Only then did O-Mitsu realize that her tears had ruined the makeup on her face.
units.source_zh: 这时阿蜜才发现自己脸上的妆已让泪水冲坏了。

paragraphs.source_zh: “荣局，怎么了？眼睛这么红。”从江户跟来的嬷嬷问她。这时阿蜜才发现自己脸上的妆已让泪水冲坏了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Did the people over there give you a hard time?”

units.source_en: “Did the people over there give you a hard time?”

paragraphs.source_en: “No. I will touch up my makeup and then go see my lady.” O-Mitsu hurried back to her own room and hastily repaired her makeup. Hideyori's lonely eyes kept rising before her own.

units.source_en: I will touch up my makeup and then go see my lady.”
units.source_zh: 我去补补妆，再去见小姐。”

units.source_en: O-Mitsu hurried back to her own room and hastily repaired her makeup.
units.source_zh: 阿蜜忙回到自己房间，匆匆补了妆。

units.source_en: Hideyori's lonely eyes kept rising before her own.
units.source_zh: 秀赖那双孤独的眼睛不断浮现在她眼前。

paragraphs.source_zh: “没有。我去补补妆，再去见小姐。”阿蜜忙回到自己房间，匆匆补了妆。秀赖那双孤独的眼睛不断浮现在她眼前。
